changelog: Upgraded the portal HTTP framework from Express 4.22 to Express 5.2.1 without changing public routes or the capture path.
Preserved controlled empty-body handling, pinned scalar query parsing and adapted startup bind-error handling.
Added migration guards for every portal route, removed APIs, rejected async handlers and occupied-port startup failures.
changelog_es: Upgraded the portal HTTP framework from Express 4.22 to Express 5.2.1 without changing public API routes or the capture path.
Preserved the established empty-JSON-body contract so validation errors remain controlled 4xx responses instead of destructuring failures.
Pinned scalar query parsing and adapted HTTP startup to Express 5's callback-based listen errors.
